item.title: “Official Time” in Agencies: What Does It Cost, and Why Is It a Political Football?
item.description: Hundreds of millions fund government union activity, and politics underlies official time and its use. 2026 is no exception.

item.title: Why “Safe” Withdrawal Rates Depend on the Type of Account You’re Spending From
item.description: Safe retirement withdrawal rates depend on the account type, as tax drag reduces sustainability for taxable and traditional IRA accounts.

item.title: New Bill Would Guarantee Pay for Federal Employees and Contractors in Government Shutdowns
item.description: Another bill has been introduced to pay federal employees and prevent layoffs during any government shutdowns in FY 2026.

item.title: Government Shutdown Officially Over
item.description: The partial government shutdown that began last weekend officially ended on Tuesday.

item.title: Affair Costs CBP Area Port Director His Job
item.description: A CBP Port Director removed based on an affair with a subordinate officer appealed to the court to try to win his job back.

item.title: OPM Reinterprets Automatic Back Pay for Furloughed Federal Employees After a Government Shutdown
item.description: OPM updated its shutdown guidance, putting guaranteed back pay after a government shutdown in doubt for furloughed federal employees.

item.title: New Federal Report Shows RTO Backfires on Federal Talent
item.description: A recent GAO report found that limiting telework at SSA led to recruiting challenges.

item.title: Schedule F and Draining the Swamp: ~50,000 Federal Jobs May Lose Civil-Service Appeal Rights
item.description: OPM issued a final Schedule F rule, stripping civil-service appeals from ~50K federal employees to ease firing and reduce efforts to derail policy initiatives.

item.title: Retirement Surge Pushes OPM Retirement Backlog Over 54k in January
item.description: The OPM retirement backlog topped 54,000 in January, but digital processing is improving efficiency.

item.title: Reinstated Reporting Shows Official Time Costs Rose 54% Over Five Years
item.description: OPM has resumed publishing official time reports, and the new data show that costs have risen sharply over a five-year period.
